matchups.preview: Up next: Supernova Takeover and Big Dumb Sports. Supernova Takeover and Big Dumb Sports have met 4 times in the regular season, with Supernova Takeover averaging 128.48 points to Big Dumb Sports's 124.53. If you want offense, check the archives: 2025 Week 3 saw this pair put up 298.62 points between them. The numbers favor Big Dumb Sports at QB by about 3.7 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're Supernova Takeover.

Chig-a-Doodle-Doo takes on theMadgician this week. This is only the second-ever meeting between Chig-a-Doodle-Doo and theMadgician; Chig-a-Doodle-Doo took the first. The numbers favor Chig-a-Doodle-Doo at QB by about 2.1 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're theMadgician. Back in 2025 Week 5, these two combined for 256.52 points -- still their high-water mark against each other.

Tanner Time is the sentimental pick against Jake From State Farm this week, because the numbers (78-22) sure aren't. Jake From State Farm holds a 8-3 career edge over Tanner Time in the regular season -- not exactly a rivalry at this point. Pat, Jamie, Nick, Mark, Anthony (Acap), Kodi, Dennis, and TJ all attended Delsea together for high school. The last playoff meeting between these two (2020 fifth_place) went to Jake From State Farm. The numbers favor Jake From State Farm at RB by about 2.4 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're Tanner Time.

This week's slate includes Supernovas vs. ROK Navy's Finest. Supernovas holds a 2-0 career edge over ROK Navy's Finest in the regular season. Supernovas is better known to the league as the exploding stars. At TE, Supernovas is projected to outscore ROK Navy's Finest by roughly 4.0 points.

Bandits and VRDNO face off this week. Bandits and VRDNO have only played once before -- Bandits won it. VRDNO projects for a real edge at RB this week -- about 2.2 points clear of Bandits there. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2025 Week 7, when they combined for 246.1 points.

On paper, this isn't close: the power scores make packerlove24 a 77% favorite over Newman’s Owen. packerlove24 holds a 8-5 career edge over Newman’s Owen in the regular season. If you want offense, check the archives: 2020 Week 4 saw this pair put up 334.98 points between them. At WR, Newman’s Owen is projected to outscore packerlove24 by roughly 5.7 points.
